title: muzzi
tagline: Simple p2p music sharing and player powered by a decentralized social graph. Share and listen to music with friends, no centralized servers, just vibes and magic.
description:
Imagine a world where you control your music and your friendships. Muzzi leverages Kinode.org's identity, social graph, and peer-to-peer tech to let you and your friends share the music y'all enjoy.

All tracks live on your device, accessible only to those you trust.

It’s simple, it's cool, and it’s yours.
how_its_made:
How it’s made

    Backend: Rust
    Frontend: React
    Networking: Kinode’s P2P primitives

Everything’s modular and minimal. No central servers mean better privacy and it's more fun.
